name: diet-api
description: The backend for the Diet Manager: owns goals, the recipe catalog, meal plans, food logs, weight tracking, coach-dieter connections, and coach feedback. Places a Dieter's lunch order by sending it as a WhatsApp message to the restaurant's contact, sends WhatsApp feedback notifications, and looks up nutrition data on behalf of the web app. Never renders UI and never holds WhatsApp/nutrition-provider credentials outside its own config.

dependencies.name: diet-db
dependencies.description: Stores goals, recipes, meal plans, food logs, weight entries, coach connections, and feedback.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the caller's token and resolves their Dieter/Coach role.

dependencies.name: whatsapp
dependencies.description: Sends the Dieter's lunch order as a WhatsApp message to the restaurant's contact, and sends the Dieter a WhatsApp message when their Coach leaves feedback.

dependencies.name: nutrition-service
dependencies.description: Looks up nutrition facts for recipes and logged foods.
